state:
**Goal `core-class-cards`: Stages 2 and 3 are done, and Stage 4 is under way.** The `codes!` macro in
`crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs` reads an optional `.card("…")` after each `Code::new(…)` and
writes `code::card(code) -> Option<&'static str>` beside `code::ALL`. The lexer band `E0001`–`E0010`,
the parser band `E0101`–`E0135`, the rejected-PHP band `E0201`–`E0254`, the name-resolution band
`E0301`–`E0327`, the whole types band `E0401`–`E0499`, the codegen codes `E0501`–`E0502` and the
configuration band from `E0601` through `E0621` carry cards. Every other code is in the test module's
`CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`, in declaration order, and `every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` holds
the two together both ways. `nvs agent show E0201` prints a code's card.

`Renderer::render_all` closes every run that rendered a coded diagnostic with `AGENT_SHOW_LINE`. Codes
declared and never raised still carry cards, because the test counts declarations: four in the parser
band (`E0103`, `E0104`, `E0106`, `E0107`), two in the rejected-PHP band (`E0206`, `E0207`), one in the
name-resolution band (`E0302`), and `E0501`, `E0502`, `E0602` and `E0603`. Stage 5 is not started.

items.text: **Drain the list, one band slice per session, in file order** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; the configuration band continues at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:2491` (`E0622`) through `E0650` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:2903`, which is about 28 codes and fills a session; `E0700` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:2927` starts the slice after it. A card is one to three sentences for the person who met the error, in the voice of AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*. Read the `///` above each code yourself with one `peek`, and send one `Explore` search for the raise sites, returning `file.rs:NN  CONSTANT  message  help` per code and `NOT RAISED` for a code nothing raises (the configuration band's raise sites are under `crates/nvs-config/src/` and carry `.with_note` and `.with_help`; many helps are caller-supplied, so ask for one caller's help per code). Peek the two or three raise sites whose help gives the fix syntax before you copy it. Write every card as one `bun nv splice --patch` (OLD `Code::new("E0622");`, NEW the `.card(…)` form), plus one block deleting the slice's codes from `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:4855`, then `rustfmt --edition 2024` the file to reflow the list. The first sentence becomes the index line, so it must read alone.

**`no_code_still_owes_a_card`** — `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`; add it beside `every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:4855`, asserting `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` is empty, in the session that deletes the list's last entry.
